theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (H G : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < a → ContinuousOn G {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → HasDerivAt H (G z) z) → (∃ C Y : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 1 ≤ Y ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, Y ≤ t → ‖G ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C * (1 + t) ^ n * Real.exp (-a * t)) → ∃ A : ℂ, Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => H ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) Filter.atTop (nhds A)
theorems.natural_summary: Restricts H to the imaginary ray and applies pinned mathlib results for exponential-moment integrability and convergence from an integrable derivative.
